user.title: Connect to Camera TTS Docker
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local Camera TTS Docker API. EZVIZ/Hikvision, Imou and Dahua cameras are discovered from Docker.

data_description.api_key: Must match API_KEY in the Docker stack

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Camera TTS
reauth_confirm.description: The Docker API rejected the saved API key. Enter the current API key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Camera TTS
reconfigure.description: Change the Docker URL/API key without removing devices or entities. Leave API key blank to keep the current key.

data_description.api_key: Leave blank to keep the current API key

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Camera TTS API
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL

abort.already_configured: This Camera TTS API is already configured

init.title: Camera TTS options
init.description: Customize idle polling and automatic Assist listening. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.poll_interval: 10–120 seconds; active playback still updates more frequently.
data_description.assist_auto_listen: Disable to avoid starting RTSP/ffmpeg automatically. Assist announcements still work.

ptz.name: Move camera PTZ
ptz.description: Move or zoom a camera through the local Docker backend.
